summary: Backend regression for Conactivos HR after fix to GET /api/users (capsules/kudos employee picker was dropping records). 43/43 pytest tests PASS (added 10 new tests in TestGetUsersAllRecords + 33 prior regression tests still green). GET /api/users validation: (a) unauthenticated -> 401/403; (b) returns exactly 13 users (3 admins + 10 employees) after POST /api/seed; (c) sorted alphabetically by name ascending; (d) every record contains required keys (_id, email, name, position, role, profile_photo, phone, birthdate, hire_date, is_employee_of_month) with correct types and no password leak; (e) legacy user inserted directly into Mongo WITHOUT 'position' and WITHOUT 'is_employee_of_month' is NOT dropped - endpoint still returns 14 users and backfills position='Empleado', is_employee_of_month=False, profile_photo/phone/birthdate/hire_date=None, role preserved as 'employee'; sort order holds with the new entry; cleanup removes legacy record; (f) source grep confirms get_users uses to_list(length=None), no to_list(1000) cap, and no response_model=List[UserResponse] strict validator. Regression confirmed: admin1 login works, /api/users/{id} returns single user without password, /api/capsules and /api/kudos reachable, POST /api/kudos still works end-to-end (uses to_user_id obtained from /api/users). All prior regression (auth, dashboard, goals, leave flow, admin guards, pausas activas, seed counts) remain green.

minor.issue: (Carried over from iteration_6) `except jwt.JWTError:` is invalid - PyJWT does not expose JWTError. Fix: replace with `except jwt.PyJWTError:` and add `except HTTPException: raise` before the JWT-error catch. Not triggered by current fix but still latent.

action_items: Fix carried-over bug: get_current_user `except jwt.JWTError:` -> `except jwt.PyJWTError:` and add `except HTTPException: raise`.
critical_code_review_comments: get_users() correctly uses to_list(length=None), sorts by name asc, and backfills optional fields with safe defaults - fix is clean and minimal.

Backfill defaults are applied in-memory only (via setdefault on the dict returned to the client); the Mongo documents remain untouched. If other read paths (e.g. /api/users/{id}, kudos resolve) also need position fallback, consider centralising the fallback or writing defaults back to DB during seed/migration.
server.py still > 1700 lines - continue previously flagged recommendation to split into routers.
Response is a plain list[dict] (no response_model). This is intentional per the fix but means Pydantic contract isn't enforced; the test suite now covers field presence.

rca_of_issue: Reported bug: Capsules & Kudos pickers were missing employees. RCA confirmed: pre-fix /api/users used response_model=List[UserResponse] which Pydantic-validated every record; any user missing required fields (position, role) would be silently dropped from the response. Secondary issues: to_list(1000) cap and a `return user` typo that could return only the last iterated item. Fix (server.py get_users): removed response_model, use to_list(length=None), sort by name asc, setdefault safe values for position/role/profile_photo/phone/birthdate/hire_date/is_employee_of_month, return the result list. Validation reproduces original failure mode by inserting a legacy user without position/is_employee_of_month directly into Mongo and asserting the endpoint still returns it (14 users total) with defaults backfilled. All 10 new tests pass; 33 prior regression tests remain green.
